# DataMind v2 — No-Code Data Insights, Interactive Charts & Predictive Workspace
> Upload any CSV, Excel, JSON, or Parquet spreadsheet and turn it into plain-English insights, 2D & 3D charts, What-If outcome predictions, and custom summary tables without writing a single line of code.

## Overview
DataMind v2 pairs a high-speed local DuckDB analytical engine with verified AI workflows so users can explore, filter, chart, combine, and forecast tabular data privately and interactively.

## Core Capabilities (4-Tab Workspace)
- **Overview & Data**: Instant Data Quality Score (completeness, missing values, duplicates) paired with fast search and row browsing across multi-sheet Excel and CSV files.
- **Insights & Charts**: Automatically surfaces key anomalies and patterns explained in plain English (`Background -> What We Found -> Data Proof -> What It Means / Next Step`), linked directly to an interactive 2D & 3D Plotly chart studio.
- **Predict & Simulate**: Choose any target column to predict; DataMind automatically prevents data leakage, benchmarks multiple ML models, ranks top driving factors, and provides real-time What-If outcome sliders.
- **Smart Tables & Pivot**: Ask for any summary table in plain English, apply point-and-click groupings and filters, visually combine multiple files, download CSVs, or convert any table into a chart in 1 click.
- **Ask DataMind AI Assistant**: Conversational data assistant that answers questions with verified numbers (even offline in Minimal DuckDB Mode) and can switch tabs, plot charts, or start predictions automatically.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS, Plotly.js, Three.js
- Backend: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0 (Async), PostgreSQL 16 (pgvector), DuckDB, Redis 7, Taskiq
- AI Engine: Local Ollama (`qwen2.5-coder:7b`) with instant deterministic DuckDB fallback
